thread:
leah - CS: FYI customer (Databridge) reporting a sudden change in parsing behavior after yesterday's rollout. Internal evals all green. customer says output now drops trailing zeros in reference ids and sometimes returns 'N/A' where it used to extract a value. attaching their prompt+response. can someone triage?

ivan - eng-runtime: Can you paste the exact request headers and model/variant they hit? Also need request_id from their failing call so we can pull logs.

leah - CS: Model: redwood-v2-medium-compat, variant: quant-8-kernelB, region: eu-west-1. Customer request_id: rb-2026-03-15-09-14-3319. Minimal repro below (sanitized).

leah - CS: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-medium-compat","input":"Extract invoice reference: \"INV-0001200\"","max_tokens":60,"temperature":0.0}'
```

leah - CS: Customer expected: "INV-0001200". Actual (customer): "INV-00012" or sometimes "N/A". Note: internal eval harness used synthetic prompts, not actual customer prompt.

sophia - eng-ml: Two quick thoughts: 1) Quantized kernels + new decoder path can change whitespace/tokenization boundaries in edge U+00A0 / NBSP cases. 2) If their input contains hidden unicode chars or zero-width spaces that our internal synthetic set didn't cover, we could miss regressions. Can you forward the raw payload (binary) or a UTF-8 hex dump? Also useful: tokenization dump (token ids) from our tokenizer for that exact string.

leah - CS: Customer provided their payload; sanitized hex dump below. They say they copy/pasted from a PDF and sometimes non-breaking spaces appear.

leah - CS: ```
Input UTF-8 hex: 45 78 74 72 61 63 74 20 69 6e 76 6f 69 63 65 20 72 65 66 65 72 65 6e 63 65 3a 20 22 49 4e 56 2d 30 30 30 31 32 30 30 22
But customer also shows a variant with 0xC2 0xA0 inserted between INV- and 0001200 (NBSP) when copy/pasted from PDF.
```

ivan - eng-runtime: Thanks. I'm reproing locally with the exact bytes and model variant. Quick check: our canary rollout yesterday included a kernel selection change to 'kernelB' for quant-8; there was also a tokenizer micro-optimization for performance (strip leading/trailing ASCII spaces earlier). That optimizer intentionally preserved NBSP but might interact with decoder detokenization differently. Repro in ~10m.

ivan - eng-runtime: Repro confirmed: when NBSP (0xC2 0xA0) is present between token groups, our detokenizer collapses the group differently with quant-8+kernelB and returns shorter chunk or fails to recognize numeric sequence, occasionally emitting fallback 'N/A' token in our postprocessing.

sophia - eng-ml: Ok that matches a hypothesis: tokenizer normalization + new detokenize path + quant kernels -> token boundary shift. Internal evals didn't flag because our eval prompt set used regular ASCII spaces. Two action items: add customer prompt variants (with NBSP and zero-width spaces) to regression suite, and create a targeted unit test that asserts exact detokenized output for byte sequences.

matt - product: Short-term, recommend routing this customer's traffic to previous variant (quant-8-kernelA) until we patch. Can CS create a fallback rule? Also need patch ETA and whether rollback should be global.

leah - CS: I've asked support to apply routing override for Databridge to quant-8-kernelA for eu-west-1. Customer ok with temporary fix but wants ETA.

ivan - eng-runtime: We'll prepare a patch to detokenizer behavior to normalize NBSP to ASCII space before detokenization, preserving semantic intent and avoiding boundary shift. I want to run that through internal perf checks. ETA: hotfix branch today, canary tomorrow, prod rollback if green.

sophia - eng-ml: I'll add the exact customer strings to the regression harness and run a sweep across quantization kernels and detokenize paths. If tests pass we can merge patch.

leah - CS: Customer updated — thanks team. They're happy with routing override. I'll keep them posted. 

matt - product: Sounds good. Once we have a PR link and canary results, please ping #eng-releases and I'll schedule a minimal global rollback if needed. :thumbsup: 

cs-bot: Routing override applied for customer Databridge -> variant quant-8-kernelA (eu-west-1). Expires: 2026-03-22T09:14:00Z.

ivan - eng-runtime: Note for postmortem — add NBSP variants to model onboarding checklist and update canary test matrix.

leah - CS: Adding to follow-up list and filing a customer-facing summary once hotfix merges. :white_check_mark:
